comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The part that surprised me most was the asterisk. The Netherlands really does grow a staggering amount under glass, and it genuinely is the world's biggest exporter of cut flowers and bulbs. But a slice of that famous export figure is food that only lands at Rotterdam, gets packed, and leaves again, and the Dutch themselves say so. Sources are listed in the description if you want to check the numbers. So where do you land: should goods that pass through a port count as that country's exports, and does your own country's trade figure have the same quiet asterisk?
